title: Evaluated PII redaction on 45 customer support tickets
details: Tested pii_redaction on real customer chats. Caught 14 SSNs and 8 Visa cards. One false positive on a software version string formatted like a phone number (1.2.3456.7890). Luhn check on credit cards worked flawlessly. Would use again.

title: Tested spatial reading order on 2-column legal SEC filings
details: PyMuPDF raw text extraction scrambled our 2-column exhibits. SpatialReadingGraph correctly ordered left column then right column across 18 pages. Failed on 1 landscape table where row tolerance was exceeded, but known issue.

title: LlamaIndex postprocessor submodular packing evaluation
details: Integrated SubmodularKnapsackPacker as postprocessor. Replaced naive top-10 chunking. Eliminated 3 near-duplicate chunks about company introduction while pulling in distinct financial metrics chapter under 1500 token budget.

title: Tried full monorepo install and hit torch download time
details: Ran pip install -r requirements.txt and took 15 minutes downloading torch for sentence-transformers. Switched to requirements-core.txt which was fast and clean. Status doc correctly noted this, but would recommend promoting aegis-docprep as default.

title: Tested REST API document upload and observed in-memory restart loss
details: Uploaded 10 documents via /v1/documents/upload. Cascading delete worked great. But after container restart, docs list was empty. STATUS.md explicitly warned that RealDocumentService is in-memory dict, so expectation was set correctly. Waiting for PostgreSQL backing.
